parameters.name: DtsInstanceID
parameters.description: The ID of the data migration, data synchronization, or change tracking instance.

parameters.name: DtsJobId
parameters.description: The ID of the data migration, data synchronization, or change tracking task.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region in which the Data Transmission Service (DTS) instance resides. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).

parameters.name: SyncSubJobHistory
parameters.description: Specifies whether to return the information about all data synchronization subtasks. Default value: **false**. A value of false indicates that the system returns only the information about a data synchronization subtask that is running or was most recently run.

parameters.name: SynchronizationDirection
parameters.description:
The synchronization direction. Valid values:

*   **Forward**
*   **Reverse**

> 

*   The default value is **Forward**.
*   The value **Reverse** takes effect only if the topology of the data synchronization instance is two-way synchronization.

parameters.name: ZeroEtlJob
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to query only zero-extract, transform, load (ETL) integration tasks. Valid values:

*   **true**
*   **false**

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts describe-dts-job-detail --dts-job-id ta7w132u12h0000 --dts-instance-id dtsta7w132u12h0000 --synchronization-direction Forward --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --sync-sub-job-history false --zero-etl-job false --resource-group-id rg-acfmzawhxxc0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dts DescribeDtsJobDetail --region cn-hangzhou --SyncSubJobHistory false --DtsJobId ta7w132u12h0000 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmzawhxxc0000' --ZeroEtlJob false --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DtsInstanceID dtsta7w132u12h0000 --SynchronizationDirection Forward
